projectName: SAP S/4HANA Cloud - Materials Management Test Data

TD-CS-022-001.name: Valid Vendor with Inspection History — Standard Scorecard View
TD-CS-022-001.expectedOutcome: Scorecard displays with all metrics; acceptance rate and OTD rate calculated correctly; visual status indicator shown

TD-CS-022-002.name: Batch Acceptance Rate — Standard Time Period (90 Days)
TD-CS-022-002.expectedOutcome: Batch acceptance rate calculated over last 90 days; formula (Accepted / Total) × 100 applied correctly

TD-CS-022-003.name: On-Time Delivery Performance — Valid PO and GR Data
TD-CS-022-003.expectedOutcome: OTD rate calculated as (On-Time Deliveries / Total Deliveries) × 100; based on PO delivery date vs actual GR date

TD-CS-022-004.name: Drill Down to Rejected Inspection Lots
TD-CS-022-004.expectedOutcome: User drills down from scorecard to detailed rejected inspection lot view; only rejected lots displayed

TD-CS-022-005.name: Export Vendor Quality Scorecard
TD-CS-022-005.expectedOutcome: Scorecard exported to selected format; report contains all key metrics and is audit-compliant

TD-CS-022-AP-001.name: Custom Time Period — Last 12 Months
TD-CS-022-AP-001.expectedOutcome: Scorecard displays metrics calculated over custom 12-month period

TD-CS-022-AP-002.name: Filter by Specific Purchasing Organization
TD-CS-022-AP-002.expectedOutcome: Scorecard displays data filtered by specified purchasing organization; metrics reflect only data for that org

TD-CS-022-AP-003.name: Vendor with Quality Threshold Met (Green Status)
TD-CS-022-AP-003.expectedOutcome: Vendor acceptance rate is above threshold; green status indicator displayed

TD-CS-022-AP-004.name: Vendor with Quality Threshold Warning (Yellow Status)
TD-CS-022-AP-004.expectedOutcome: Vendor acceptance rate is near threshold (within warning range); yellow status indicator displayed

TD-CS-022-NEG-001.name: Non-Existent Vendor ID
TD-CS-022-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: System displays error message: Vendor does not exist; scorecard is not displayed

TD-CS-022-NEG-002.name: Vendor with No Inspection History
TD-CS-022-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: Scorecard displays with zero inspection lots; acceptance rate not calculable or displayed as N/A

TD-CS-022-NEG-003.name: No Rejected Inspection Lots Exist
TD-CS-022-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: Rejected lots metric shows 0; drill-down link is disabled or displays empty list with informational message

TD-CS-022-NEG-004.name: Vendor with No Purchase Orders or Goods Receipts
TD-CS-022-NEG-004.expectedOutcome: OTD metrics display as zero or N/A; no delivery data available message displayed

TD-CS-022-NEG-005.name: Vendor Falls Below Quality Threshold (Red Flag)
TD-CS-022-NEG-005.expectedOutcome: Vendor acceptance rate is below threshold; red status indicator (flag) is displayed prominently

TD-CS-022-ERR-001.name: Missing Vendor ID Field
TD-CS-022-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: System highlights Vendor field as mandatory; Go button is disabled or query is blocked; error message displayed

TD-CS-022-ERR-002.name: Invalid Date Range (To Date Before From Date)
TD-CS-022-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: System displays error message: To Date must be after From Date; query is not executed

TD-CS-022-ERR-003.name: Export Fails Due to Insufficient Authorization
TD-CS-022-ERR-003.expectedOutcome: Export action is blocked; error message displayed: User does not have authorization to export vendor quality reports

TD-CS-022-EDGE-001.name: Time Period = 1 Day (Minimum Boundary)
TD-CS-022-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Scorecard displays metrics for 1-day period; system accepts minimum boundary; calculations are performed correctly

TD-CS-022-EDGE-002.name: Time Period = 3 Years (Maximum Boundary)
TD-CS-022-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: Scorecard displays metrics for 3-year period; system accepts maximum boundary; performance is acceptable for large data volume

TD-CS-022-EDGE-003.name: Quality Threshold = 0% (All Vendors Flagged)
TD-CS-022-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: Threshold set to 0%; all vendors (including this one) are flagged as red regardless of actual acceptance rate

TD-CS-022-EDGE-004.name: Quality Threshold = 100% (No Vendors Flagged)
TD-CS-022-EDGE-004.expectedOutcome: Threshold set to 100%; only vendors with 100% acceptance rate would not be flagged; this vendor shows green or yellow status

TD-CS-022-EDGE-005.name: Batch Acceptance Rate = 0% (All Lots Rejected)
TD-CS-022-EDGE-005.expectedOutcome: Acceptance rate displays as 0.00%; red status indicator shown; calculation handles zero accepted lots correctly

TD-CS-022-EDGE-006.name: Batch Acceptance Rate = 100% (All Lots Accepted)
TD-CS-022-EDGE-006.expectedOutcome: Acceptance rate displays as 100.00%; green status indicator shown; calculation handles zero rejected lots correctly

TD-CS-022-EDGE-007.name: On-Time Delivery Rate = 0% (All Deliveries Late)
TD-CS-022-EDGE-007.expectedOutcome: OTD rate displays as 0.00%; red status indicator shown; calculation handles zero on-time deliveries correctly

TD-CS-022-EDGE-008.name: On-Time Delivery Rate = 100% (All Deliveries On-Time)
TD-CS-022-EDGE-008.expectedOutcome: OTD rate displays as 100.00%; calculation handles zero late deliveries correctly

TD-CS-022-INT-001.name: Verify Batch Acceptance Rate Aggregates QM Inspection Lot Results
TD-CS-022-INT-001.expectedOutcome: Acceptance rate in scorecard matches manual calculation from QM inspection lot source data; integration with QM module is correct

TD-CS-022-INT-002.name: Verify On-Time Delivery Calculation Uses PO and GR Dates
TD-CS-022-INT-002.expectedOutcome: OTD rate in scorecard matches manual calculation comparing PO delivery dates (EKPO-EINDT) vs GR posting dates (MKPF-BUDAT); integration with MM module is correct
